cases.criterion: A non-trivial request sent through /start reaches the start gateway, is dispatched with exactly one Task(start) call, and the final answer waits for that Task result.
cases.evidence: transcript and Task metadata for the /start run

cases.criterion: At nesting depth L3-L4 the subagent returns the structured depth marker to the root, and no L5 child task is created in the task tree.
cases.evidence: task-tree metadata and runtime log for the nesting run

cases.criterion: With spawn budget 0 the runtime creates no child Task, the model cannot raise remaining_spawns, and the Task result reports the exhausted budget.
cases.evidence: Task tool result and task-tree metadata for the budget-0 run

cases.criterion: An HTTP 429 retries the same request through the next proxy, an unreachable proxy is skipped for 60 seconds, and with every proxy dead the request goes direct.
cases.evidence: proxy rotation warnings and request log for one model call

cases.criterion: No phantom charge: a request is rejected only when actual usage exceeds the configured limit, and the recorded usage equals the provider-reported usage.
cases.evidence: session usage row and provider usage metadata for the same request
